definitions.explanation: Living organisms that typically grow in a fixed place, absorbing water and nutrients through roots.

examples.japanese: {植物|しょくぶつ}を{育|そだ}てるのが{趣味|しゅみ}です。
{植物|しょくぶつ}{園|えん}で{珍|めずら}しい{花|はな}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw rare flowers at the botanical garden.

examples.japanese: {植物|しょくぶつ}は{光合成|こうごうせい}で{酸素|さんそ}を{作|つく}る。

notes:
{植物|しょくぶつ} is the scientific/formal term for plants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {植物|しょくぶつ}{園|えん} (botanical garden)
- {植物|しょくぶつ}{性|せい} (plant-based, vegetable)
- {観葉|かんよう}{植物|しょくぶつ} (foliage plant, houseplant)
- {多肉|たにく}{植物|しょくぶつ} (succulent plant)
- {植物|しょくぶつ}{油|あぶら} (vegetable oil)

COMPARISON:
- {植物|しょくぶつ}: plant (scientific/formal)
- {草木|くさき}: plants and trees (literary)
- {花|はな}: flower
